notes: The Copenhagen Card (72 hours, 889 DKK) covers transport and museums, including Louisiana, Kronborg and Roskilde; it pays for itself on this plan. Bikes cost 100-150 per day and the city is flat. The airport is 15 minutes by metro.
Summer temperatures are 20-24°C and daylight lasts until 22:00. Try harbour swimming (Islands Brygge), Reffen, Tivoli Friday concerts and Roskilde Festival (late June to July).
Coffee is 45 DKK, smørrebrød 90-150, a restaurant meal 250-400, a beer 60; no tipping. Cards are accepted everywhere (no cash needed).
New Nordic cuisine: Noma has closed, but Geranium and Alchemist remain. Affordable options: Hija de Sanchez, Gasoline Grill burgers, Juno and Hart bakeries.
Photo rules apply in Christiania (none on green light); Pusher Street is closed. Don't walk in the bike lane (cyclists will ring their bells).
Kronborg and Louisiana are covered by the Copenhagen Card; Tivoli's lights come on after 17:00.

transit.name: Copenhagen Card
transit.why_chosen: More than 80 museums plus all public transport (including Louisiana, Kronborg and Roskilde); 889 DKK for 3 days
transit.coverage: Metro, S-tog, otobüs, liman otobüsü, bölgesel tren

stops.name: Nyhavn
stops.tips: Colourful 17th-century harbour; Andersen lived at number 20. Empty in the morning, and canal tours leave from here.

stops.name: Canal Tour Copenhagen
stops.tips: One-hour canal tour (Stromma/Netto is cheaper); see the Little Mermaid from the water, plus the Opera House and Christianshavn.

stops.name: Amalienborg Palace
stops.tips: The royal residence; changing of the guard at 12:00, with the dome of the Marble Church beyond.

stops.name: Torvehallerne
stops.tips: Glass market hall at Nørreport; Hallernes smørrebrød (open sandwiches), Grød porridge, Coffee Collective.

stops.name: Rundetårn
stops.tips: Round Tower from 1642; a spiral ramp leads up to views over the city.

backups.name: Schønnemann
backups.tips: A smørrebrød institution since 1877; book ahead, and try the herring with schnapps.

backups.name: Designmuseum Danmark
backups.tips: A corridor of Danish design chairs; an alternative to Rundetårn.

stops.name: Rosenborg Castle
stops.tips: Renaissance castle; the crown jewels are in the basement, and the King's Garden is next door.

stops.name: Kongens Have
stops.tips: The King's Garden; picnics and puppet theatre in summer.

stops.name: Statens Museum for Kunst
stops.tips: National gallery; Matisse and the Danish Golden Age.

stops.name: Aamanns 1921
stops.tips: Modern smørrebrød; book ahead.

stops.name: Tivoli Gardens
stops.tips: Amusement park and garden from 1843 that inspired Disney. Lights come on in the evening, with free Friday summer concerts. Entry is 175 plus a ride ticket; Christmas and Halloween seasons in winter.

backups.name: Tivoli Food Hall
backups.tips: Food hall next to the park; no entry ticket needed.

backups.name: Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek
backups.tips: Rodin, Gauguin and a winter garden; an alternative to SMK, free on Tuesdays.

stops.name: Church of Our Saviour
stops.tips: Tower with an external spiral staircase, 400 steps; views over the Christianshavn canals.

stops.name: Freetown Christiania
stops.tips: Hippie autonomous district founded in 1971; Pusher Street was closed (2024). Photo rules apply; cafés, Grå Hal.

stops.name: Reffen Street Food
stops.tips: Container street food market on Refshaleøen (April to October); take the harbour bus.

stops.name: Copenhagen Opera House
stops.tips: Henning Larsen's opera house on Holmen; view from outside.

stops.name: Copenhill Amager Bakke
stops.tips: Ski slope and hiking trail on the roof of a waste-to-energy plant; the city views are free.

backups.name: Christianshavns Bådudlejning
backups.tips: Café on the canal; boats for hire.

backups.name: Danish Architecture Center BLOX
backups.tips: Architecture centre with a slide; an alternative to Copenhill.

stops.name: Louisiana Museum of Modern Art
stops.tips: 35 minutes by train (Humlebæk); Giacometti, Kusama and a sculpture garden overlooking the Øresund, one of the world's most beautiful museums.

stops.name: Louisiana Café
stops.tips: Museum café with sea views; smørrebrød buffet.

stops.name: Kronborg Castle
stops.tips: Helsingør: Hamlet's Elsinore, with Holger Danske in the casemates and the Swedish coast across the water.

stops.name: Helsingør Old Town
stops.tips: Medieval streets and the Maritime Museum (BIG); take the train back.

backups.name: Brasserie Kronborg
backups.tips: On Helsingør harbour, next to the castle.

backups.name: Karen Blixen Museum Rungstedlund
backups.tips: Home of the author of Out of Africa; on the way to Louisiana, an alternative to Kronborg.

stops.name: Carlsberg Byen
stops.tips: Former brewery district; the Elephant Gate and Home of Carlsberg (visitor centre 130 DKK).

stops.name: Frederiksberg Gardens
stops.tips: Romantic park and palace; canal boats, and you can see the zoo's elephants.

stops.name: Værnedamsvej
stops.tips: The 'Little Paris' street; granola brunch, cheesemonger and wine shop.

stops.name: Kødbyen Meatpacking
stops.tips: The White Meatpacking District; galleries and evening bars.

stops.name: Warpigs Kødbyen
stops.tips: Mikkeller x Three Floyds beer and Texas BBQ.

backups.name: Copenhagen Zoo
backups.tips: Zoo in Frederiksberg; elephant house by Norman Foster.

stops.name: Assistens Kirkegård
stops.tips: Cemetery-park where Andersen and Kierkegaard are buried; the yellow wall of Nørrebro.

stops.name: Superkilen Park
stops.tips: BIG's red and black multicultural park; Moroccan fountain, Thai boxing ring.

stops.name: Jægersborggade
stops.tips: Nørrebro's hip street; Grød, Meyers Bageri, Coffee Collective.

stops.name: Viking Ship Museum Roskilde
stops.tips: 25 minutes by train; five original Viking ships and the fjord. In summer you can go aboard a ship (May to September).

stops.name: Roskilde Cathedral
stops.tips: Burial place of 40 Danish monarchs; UNESCO-listed brick Gothic.

backups.name: Frederiksborg Castle Hillerød
backups.tips: Renaissance castle on a lake, home to the Museum of National History; an alternative to Roskilde.

days.theme: Little Mermaid and a gentle farewell

stops.name: Kastellet
stops.tips: Star-shaped fortress and windmill; morning joggers.

stops.name: The Little Mermaid
stops.tips: Statue from 1913 at Langelinie; small and crowded, but a must.

stops.name: Gefion Fountain & St Alban's
stops.tips: The fountain with oxen and the English church.

stops.name: Juno the Bakery Østerbro
stops.tips: The city's best bakery; kardemommebolle (cardamom bun) and a farewell coffee.

stops.name: Østerport Metro Airport
stops.tips: Metro or train to Kastrup in 15 minutes; farewell.

backups.name: Nyboder
backups.tips: Yellow sailors' houses; an alternative to the fountain.
